items.title: Frank Wess interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: And I did a couple of things while I was working with Blanche Calloway. Well I was with Blanche at the time, you know, 1940.

ctx.x: What about your writing? Were you writing before the Basie band?

Yeah. Well I’ve been writing. I think I did my first commercial arrangement in 1940 I think, for the old entertainer, I don’t know, you probably never heard of Fifi D’Orsay from Canada. I did an arrangement on “Alouette” for her. Years, years, years ago. And I did a couple of things while I was working with Blanche Calloway. Well I was with Blanche at the time, you know, 1940. So that started. And then all in the service I guess for about, oh four years, I had a band. I had a 17 piece band in the service. And we…
This is while you’re still in the service?
